newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end firmer, seen rising further.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end firmer, seen rising further.

text.p: 1828 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended firmer and were expected to rise more amid hopes of a Portuguese key rate cut on Friday. *June 97 futures up 0.08 points to 107.24 *Feb 07 cash 99.04 (98.87), yld 6.76 vs 6.78 cls *Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -8 bps vs -9 bps
Portuguese bonds ended firmer and were expected to rise further amid hopes of a cut in Portuguese key rates on Friday, dealers said.
"Remarks by the Bank of Portugal governor boosted the optimism of the market over prospects for a rate cut on Friday," said one operator.
Central bank governor Antonio de Sousa told reporters that year-on-year inflation would hit lows in the second quarter not seen since the 1960s.
